about: Systems administrator who keeps infrastructure quietly dependable, with a habit of automating the repetitive work before it becomes a fire drill. I enjoy untangling messy environments and leaving behind clear documentation and predictable maintenance routines.

experiences.description: Maintain and harden the server and network estate for a mid-sized hosting operation, handling patching, backups, and incident response. Automate routine provisioning and monitoring so the team can focus on the cases that genuinely need attention.

Ran the internal infrastructure for a growing engineering office, covering identity, storage, and virtualization. Led a migration to a more resilient backup scheme and cut recurring outages by stabilizing the update process.

Administered hybrid environments spanning on-premise servers and cloud workloads, focusing on monitoring and capacity planning. Built scripted health checks that caught failures before users noticed them.

Supported the operations team with ticket resolution, user account management, and routine server maintenance. Documented common procedures and helped standardize the onboarding setup for new workstations.

projects.title: Booking Platform Failover Overhaul
projects.summary: Re-architected the hosting and recovery setup for a travel agency's cloud-based booking platform so peak-season load no longer threatened uptime. Introduced automated failover and clearer runbooks, which shortened recovery during incidents and reduced manual intervention.

projects.title: Property Portal Build Toolchain
projects.summary: Stood up the administration and build environment behind a real estate development portal, supporting cross-platform client applications on Linux servers. Tuned the deployment pipeline and access controls so developers could ship without stepping on shared infrastructure.
